name: pxlkit
description: Free to Use Retro React UI kit & pixel art icon library. Includes 40+ React components, 200+ hand-crafted SVG pixel icons (static & animated), and a visual builder. Built with TypeScript & Next.js.

paragraphs: Bring retro aesthetics to the modern web with React — and, new in 2.2, with Vue and Angular.

Pxlkit is a retro pixel-art UI kit for React: 111 components, 226+ pixel-art SVG icons in 7 themed packs, animated and 3D parallax icons, toast notifications, a visual icon builder and 6 page templates. New in 2.2: the same kit and icon components for Vue 3 and Angular, checked against React by parity tests.

Pxlkit.xyz is a monorepo containing a retro UI kit of 111 components for React — now also for Vue and Angular — 226+ pixel art icons organized into 7 themed packs, a framework-agnostic rendering engine with React, Vue and Angular icon components, a 3D voxel toolkit in early preview (its procedural world engine runs live at /explore), and a Next.js 15 showcase website. Every icon is a 16×16 character grid mapped to a color palette — designed to be hand-editable, AI-generatable, and version-control friendly. Browse and visually edit them at the official website.
